description: This Java class 'SynthEngine' implements a simple polyphonic, single-channel MIDI synthesizer for Android. It processes MIDI events, manages voice synthesis, and outputs audio through a background thread. The class handles MIDI message parsing, voice creation, and manages the synthesis loop.

classes.name: SynthEngine
classes.description: A simple polyphonic MIDI synthesizer running on a background thread, processing MIDI events, and generating audio output.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Handles incoming MIDI data, forwarding it to the event scheduler if not an active sensing message.

methods.name: logMidiMessage
methods.description: Logs the MIDI message bytes for debugging purposes.

methods.name: processMidiEvents
methods.description: Processes scheduled MIDI events and sends them to the MIDI framer.

methods.name: generateBuffer
methods.description: Generates the audio buffer by mixing all active voices.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Stops a note on a specified channel and note index.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Starts a note with given velocity on a specified channel and note index.

methods.name: pitchBend
methods.description: Adjusts pitch bend range and updates the frequency scaler for all voices.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the synthesis thread and initializes MIDI event scheduling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the synthesis thread and cleans up resources.
